diagram_candidates.title: Exact binary QFT circuit
diagram_candidates.claim: The algorithm specifies ordered wires q_(n−1),…,q_0; descending Hadamard and controlled-phase blocks; and a final layer of pairwise swaps.
diagram_candidates.concrete_content: A parameterized circuit diagram with one row per ordered wire; H on q_j followed by CP_(j−i+1) from q_i to q_j in the stated chronological order, then swaps q_j↔q_(n−1−j). Preserve the stated wire convention and n=0 empty-circuit case.
diagram_candidates.uncertainty: Editorial candidate. The gate list is already explicit; the diagram would make wire orientation and operation order easier to scan.

diagram_candidates.title: Feynman–Kitaev history Hamiltonian
diagram_candidates.claim: The definition encodes time by legal unary clock words and gives exact local pre/post windows for each propagation edge, then separates input, output, propagation, and clock-penalty terms.
diagram_candidates.concrete_content: A clock strip showing legal words |1^t0^(T−t)>, adjacent t−1→t propagation, the stated boundary/interior windows (0↔1, 00↔10, 10↔11, 100↔110), and labels for H_in, H_prop,t, H_out, and H_clock with their computation/clock support.
diagram_candidates.uncertainty: Editorial candidate. All labels and local patterns are stated in the source; a schematic could clarify the clock locality and boundary cases.
